findings.title: New installations bypass the authenticated-user check
findings.body: When the installation ID has no `Integration` record yet, this branch advances the pipeline directly to integration creation without comparing the OAuth-authenticated GitHub user with the installation sender. This is a normal race if the installation webhook has not arrived before the redirect, and the subsequent integration creation does not perform this comparison either. As a result, a Sentry user can associate an installation created by a different GitHub user, defeating the security check this change is intended to add.

findings.title: Missing sender metadata causes an unhandled exception
findings.body: `build_integration` only adds `metadata.sender` when sender data is present, so an existing integration can legitimately lack this key. Indexing `integration.metadata["sender"]["login"]` then raises `KeyError` and returns a server error instead of the installation failure response. Handle absent sender metadata as a failed verification.
